newsitem.title: DENMARK: Copenhagen bourse to extend trading hours in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Copenhagen bourse to extend trading hours in Sept.

text.p: Copenhagen Stock Exchange said on Thursday it would extend the daily opening hours of share and bond trading systems by 90 minutes, effective September 8.
It said that trading would continue to start at 9:00a.m. (0700 GMT) from Monday-Friday but that the close would be 90 minutes later than at present at 5:00 pm (1500 GMT).

"The extended opening hours present opportunities to Danish market participants to make better use of trading information from international exchanges, specifically from New York Stock Exchange," the bourse said in a statement.

It said the new trading hours would give Copenhagen a 90 minute overlap with New York, with London Stock Exchange closing only 30 minutes after Copenhagen and securities trading ending at the same time in Denmark as in Sweden. -- Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
